verdict.rationale: No official SDK appears anywhere in the evidence. CodeRabbit does publish an OpenAPI spec at docs.coderabbit.ai/openapi.json, and a community comment refers to calling CodeRabbit's API, so developers can build against the API or generate their own client from the spec. That is a workaround that needs extra tooling, not an official SDK. Missing for 10: any first-party SDK in any language, SDK documentation or package distribution, and independent corroboration of programmatic integration.
